metadata_replay: Require the same column set and canonical rows across every returned field. Row/column ordering may change; report byte equality separately. Empty results require the expected headers. Any content/schema change requires review.

discovery.sample_query_scope: 144 original host BioSamples and 38 original phage BioSamples, batches of at most 20, searched in assembly/analysis/sequence indexes without requiring the original project.
discovery.finding: Original-project queries returned no assemblies. Cross-project BioSample queries found 143 host assemblies/analyses; selected EMBL-EBI analysis FASTAs in PRJEB126751 explicitly reference the original DRR runs. No assembled records were found for the 38 phage samples in these indexed searches.
discovery.limit: This is not a proof of global absence of additional assemblies. Third-party assemblies are not the original paper assemblies.

missing_host.status: No assembled record found in these project/BioSample searches; original paired reads are available.

quality_scope: Verify file bytes/MD5, gzip decoding, source BioSample and original-run references, nonempty IUPAC DNA, contig count, length, N50, ambiguity and GC. Preserve all source contigs and ambiguous bases. No quality-based cohort exclusion or training admission.
exact_overlap_scope: Reuse cohort.canonical_assembly_digest against the frozen 177-host/94-phage sequence identities and within the acquired panel. This normalizes headers, case, contig order and strand; it does not normalize circular rotation, different contig boundaries or reassemblies. No near-duplicate, contamination or completeness assessment is claimed.
remaining_work: Resolve phenotype reuse terms and source endpoint/publication discrepancies.
Obtain or assemble host 127 and the 38 read-only phage routes; complete phenotype/sequence/stock joins.
Assess contamination/completeness and exact/near-duplicate strain relationships before freezing host groups and a separate panel protocol.
